name: Stewed Plum Cinnamon Bowl
ingredients: Zest and juice of ½ orange
1 cup plain unsweetened high-protein soy yogurt
steps: Place the plums, cinnamon, star anise, orange zest and juice and 3 tbsp water in a pan.
Simmer covered on low for 10–12 minutes until the plums are soft; remove the spices.
Toast the oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Divide the yogurt into two bowls and spoon over the plums and their juice.
Top with the oats and cardamom.
note: Ripe plums need no sugar; cooking brings out their natural sweetness.
